transcript.text: Hi, I'm reviewing the MSA terms for Smallest AI. I have a few questions.
Hello, this is the Legal Coordination Desk at Smallest AI. How can I help you with your legal process today?
I can certainly help with that. What specific questions do you have about the MSA terms?
What's your standard position on liability caps?
Our standard position is that liability is capped at the fees paid by the client in the preceding 12 months. We do not accept unlimited liability.
And what about data processing? Do you use our data for training?
No, we do not use customer data to train our models. We process your data strictly for the delivery of the service.
We need unlimited liability for data breaches. Is that possible?
I cannot agree to unlimited liability. For any modifications to our standard terms, please reach out to Manjari at legal@smallest.ai, and she can connect you with our legal team for review.
